retainedTuple.mechanics: Snapshot own property descriptors, read each supported identity field once into primitives; retain the existing provider-coordinate and processing-reference structures explicitly. retainedTuple.captureBoundary: The original source alias reuses its already retained center tuple. An actual assembled snapshot projection materializes its center fields once and must exactly match the retained source tuple. Original spatial object uses its retained producer result; snapshot clones independently materialize and match the full retained spatial state. Source identity and processing references are materialized once, validated, and captured from those values.
retainedTuple.aliasLimit: Object identity only selects an already retained tuple; it does not establish an otherwise missing producer association. Unbound copied/reconstructed/directional lookalikes cannot create authority. A changed, separately assembled observation refuses; mutation of an original source after retention cannot rewrite the retained observation.
retainedTuple.normalization: Explicit pelora-source-normalization-v1 call-path binding plus exactly one matching normalization processing reference. No historical default or upgrade.
retainedTuple.availability: Only the retained governed centerTemperatureAvailable Boolean supplies available/unavailable. Missing/non-Boolean/contradictory states refuse. Finite-F equivalence checks the existing producer invariant; it never supplies the enum.
retainedTuple.falseFinite: CENTER_FALSE_FINITE_IS_PRODUCER_CONTRADICTION for finite Fahrenheit: the existing producer uses Number.isFinite(retained Fahrenheit). Generic v2 unavailable diagnostics remain unchanged. The helper retains a permitted finite Celsius diagnostic with null Fahrenheit; the default marine conversion normally produces both null on rejection.
retainedTuple.numericalLimit: Capture-v2 independently validates existing numeric/source constraints. It does not establish C/F conversion equality or new range/precision rules; this repair does not add them.
retainedTuple.readCounts: Celsius and Fahrenheit getter counts equal 1 at each materialization boundary, including original-source alias reuse. Changing and throwing-second getters pass; first-read failure refuses without retry or spatial invocation.
retainedTuple.signedZero: Celsius +0/-0 remain distinct exact references; Fahrenheit signed-zero primitives are retained without truthiness. Exact serialization/reconstruction preserves governed distinctions.
retainedTuple.postMaterialization: Original C/F, coordinates, time, spatial version/Boolean and provenance backing mutations cannot rewrite already retained values or created envelopes.
